previousRule: A cushion fabric without a separate usable-width field cannot receive a binding cutting plan. Missing full width also prevents physical image calibration. My Home groups missing cutting, stock and cost evidence into broad confirmation messages.
newRule: Use the separately recorded usable width when present. If only one physical width is recorded, use it for both full and usable width. If neither is recorded, use the owner-approved 1370 mm fallback for cutting and physical preview scale, with explicit provenance. A fabric whose current-range lifecycle is not CURRENT remains unpriced and unavailable for cushion purchase. My Home names that restriction and directs the customer to Edit.
reason: The live saved My Home review showed Amalfi Herb and Acies Amethyst as awaiting confirmation with a misleading fabric-shortage explanation. Their governed current-range status is UNKNOWN, although the recent stock observations cover the shown quantities. The owner clarified the width hierarchy, including the 1370 mm fallback when neither width exists.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner explicitly confirmed that one recorded width serves as both full and usable cutting width, and that 1370 mm is the fallback for cutting and preview scale when neither width is recorded. Existing lifecycle, stock, price and checkout safeguards remain in force. The exact PR head still needs a Nylon1 approval comment before protected merge.
